description:
Get aligned financial-state time series

Return one aligned EDGAR financial-state row per fiscal period for a company. The response aligns the income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement public at the boundary by fiscal period, preserves decimal-string values, and uses deterministic ordering by period_end ASC, fiscal_year ASC, fiscal_period ASC with tie-break on cik.

as_of_date.description: Return values only from filings public by this date, as they stood on it.

cik.description: Company CIK as digits (for example 0000320193), or a ticker symbol (for example AAPL). A ticker resolves to the company whose filings hold its statements as of the request's as-of or period-end date, or as of today when the request has none.

fiscal_period.description: Return only this fiscal period: FY with period_type annual, or one of Q1 to Q4 with period_type quarterly.

fiscal_year_from.description: Return only fiscal years at or after this year.

fiscal_year_to.description: Return only fiscal years at or before this year.

include_macro_context.description: Include the approved macroeconomic series aligned to each period.

include_provenance.description: Include the filing and XBRL fact each value was read from.

period_type.description: Periods to return: annual (the default) or quarterly.

name: edgar_companies_financial_state_time_series
